faqs.question: Does this JavaScript compiler support modern ES6+ features?
faqs.answer: Yes. It supports arrow functions, async/await, Promises, destructuring, template literals, optional chaining, Map/Set, and all standard ECMAScript APIs.

faqs.question: How does console output work?
faqs.answer: All calls to console.log, console.warn, console.error, and console.table are intercepted and formatted into a structured terminal view below the code editor.

faqs.question: Is my JavaScript executed safely?
faqs.answer: Yes, code is executed in an isolated browser context, protecting your session data and personal storage.

faqs.question: Can I copy and download my JS scripts?
faqs.answer: Yes, with one click you can copy the code to your clipboard or download it as a .js file.

faqs.question: Is my JavaScript code uploaded to an external server?
faqs.answer: No. Code execution occurs strictly within your browser's local JavaScript engine. No code is transmitted across the internet.

faqs.question: Can the script access cookies or sensitive browser storage?
faqs.answer: No. The execution environment is sandboxed to prevent malicious reads from localStorage, cookies, or parent document nodes.

faqs.question: What happens if I write an infinite loop (e.g., while(true))?
faqs.answer: An infinite loop can temporarily freeze the execution thread until the browser's script timeout interrupts execution or you close the tab.

faqs.question: Are modern ES6+ features supported?
faqs.answer: Yes. Arrow functions, async/await, destructuring, classes, Promises, and optional chaining are fully supported by your browser's native V8/SpiderMonkey engine.

faqs.question: Does this JavaScript compiler support modern ES6+ features?
faqs.answer: Yes. It supports arrow functions, async/await, Promises, destructuring, template literals, optional chaining, Map/Set, and all standard ECMAScript APIs.

faqs.question: How does console output work?
faqs.answer: All calls to console.log, console.warn, console.error, and console.table are intercepted and formatted into a structured terminal view below the code editor.

faqs.question: Is my JavaScript executed safely?
faqs.answer: Yes, code is executed in an isolated browser context, protecting your session data and personal storage.

faqs.question: Can I copy and download my JS scripts?
faqs.answer: Yes, with one click you can copy the code to your clipboard or download it as a .js file.

faqs.question: O código é enviado para algum servidor?
faqs.answer: Não. O script roda diretamente no motor JavaScript local do seu navegador.

faqs.question: O código consegue acessar cookies ou dados salvos?
faqs.answer: Não. O isolamento do sandbox impede a leitura de cookies ou localStorage.

faqs.question: O que ocorre em caso de loop infinito?
faqs.answer: O navegador pode pausar a execução temporariamente até que o limite de tempo seja atingido.

faqs.question: Recursos modernos do ES6+ funcionam normalmente?
faqs.answer: Sim. Classes, Promises, async/await e desestruturação são suportados nativamente.
